name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.channels.ChannelsActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this screen when the app asks the user to manage search channels. It shows active channels, lets the user reorder them or open channel selection, and saves or discards changes.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage the channels used by the app's iQNECT searches.
